command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
# #997 MIGRATION — MIG-19. The state HERMES is left in, after the bench and the soak.
# The card was driven to the 85 C abort by this lane; confirming it came back down is part of
# leaving the machine properly rather than just leaving it.

Write-Output "now_utc=$((Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o'))"
Write-Output '--- GPUS ---'
& 'C:\Windows\System32\nvidia-smi.exe' --query-gpu=uuid,name,driver_model.current,power.limit,power.default_limit,temperature.gpu,power.draw,memory.used,utilization.gpu --format=csv,noheader
Write-Output '--- P40 ECC (like-for-like) ---'
& 'C:\Windows\System32\nvidia-smi.exe' -i GPU-4f7d4396-9304-d12f-7e9b-7f04d1236fc2 -q -d ECC | Select-String -Pattern 'Volatile|Aggregate|Total' | Select-Object -First 8 | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim() }
Write-Output '--- ONE OWNER ---'
Write-Output "task=$((Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'WilliamOS-HERMES-Ollama').State)"
Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name = 'ollama.exe'" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
    ForEach-Object { "pid=$($_.ProcessId) ppid=$($_.ParentProcessId) cmd=$(($_.CommandLine -split '\s+' | Select-Object -First 2) -join ' ')" }
Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 11434 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { "listener=$($_.LocalAddress):$($_.LocalPort) pid=$($_.OwningProcess)" }
Write-Output "containers_named_ollama=$((docker ps -a --filter name=ollama --format '{{.Names}}' 2>&1) -join ',')"
Write-Output '--- STACK ---'
docker ps --format '{{.Names}}|{{.Status}}' 2>&1
Write-Output '--- API ---'
try { $t = Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/tags' -TimeoutSec 15; Write-Output "models=$($t.models.Count)" } catch { Write-Output "api_ERR=$($_.Exception.Message)" }
Write-Output '--- MODEL LIBRARY ---'
$b = Get-ChildItem 'D:\HermesData\ollama\models\blobs' -File | Measure-Object -Sum Length
Write-Output "D blobs=$($b.Count) bytes=$($b.Sum)   (expected 21 / 10360071891)"
$g = Get-ChildItem 'G:\HermesData\ollama\models\blobs' -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object -Sum Length
Write-Output "G blobs=$($g.Count) bytes=$($g.Sum)   (expected 12 / 7180381648, untouched)"
Write-Output '--- LANE SCAFFOLDING GONE ---'
Get-ScheduledTask -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.TaskName -match 'MIG-997' } | ForEach-Object { "LEFTOVER $($_.TaskName)" }
Write-Output "probe_dirs_left=$((Test-Path 'D:\HermesServices\ollama\_probe'))"
Write-Output '--- RC ---'
